name: texture-uniform-tile
prompt: Tile pattern that samples a sampler2D uniform called uPattern (unbound for now) and mixes it over a procedural base so it still looks good without a texture.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote a tile-pattern shader layer but didn't apply it or compile it, because no Powermove tools were attached to this run. The base is offset brick tiles with Truchet arcs, bevels and grout. `uPattern` is sampled per tile and mixed in by `uPatternMix`; when the texture reads as empty or unbound, only the procedural base shows. A fully black texture will also be read as empty, and if the renderer leaves another texture bound to unit 0, the shader will sample that one.
